name: k8s-name
notes: Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure k3s (release 068). The fault proxy on VM-C terminates TLS (throwaway certificate) and re-opens TLS to the API server, so faults act on the HTTP request and reply, not on the handshake. Identity = metadata.name: AlreadyExists dedups for as long as the object exists, GET by name is a receipt query, a tombstone created first under the same name is a per-identity stop (create-if-absent). Measured locally against k3s v1.36.4+k3s1 before release: K3 (D_h, Q_A, Q_S), late effect without a stop. Release 070: P5 retries the same identity after beyond_gap_s = 600 s, so the measured D_h lower bound is 600 s instead of P4's 2 s (a declared unbounded horizon can never be shown by a finite probe); adds about 10 minutes per repetition.
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
